{'translation': "Listen to 9to5Mac as we recap today's top news stories. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, and can also be accessed via our exclusive RSS feed on Overcast and other podcast players.", 'chinese_translation': '收聽 9to5Mac，與我們一起回顧今日頭條新聞。9to5Mac Daily 喺 iTunes、Apple Podcasts、Stitcher、TuneIn、Google Play 都聽得到，亦可以透過我哋嘅獨家 RSS feed 喺 Overcast 同其他播客播放器收聽。'}

{'translation': 'Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you organize everything in your head into one simple, elegant system, helping you close those open loops and lighten your mental load. An easy-to-use to-do list app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with powerful built-in tools to help you categorize, track, and get everything done. Get stuff done with Stuff.', 'chinese_translation': '由 Stuff 贊助：Stuff 幫你將腦入面所有嘢整理成一個簡單優雅嘅系統，幫你關閉未完成嘅循環，減輕你嘅心理負擔。一個容易用嘅待辦清單 App，支援 iPhone、iPad 同 Mac，內置強大工具幫你分類、追蹤、搞掂所有工作。等你用 Stuff 搞掂所有嘢。'}

{'translation': "9to5Mac Daily releases new episodes every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player, and you'll be notified as soon as a new episode drops.", 'chinese_translation': '9to5Mac Daily 逢工作日都會有新一集。喺 Apple Podcasts 或者你最鍾意嘅播客播放器訂閱我哋，新一集一出就會即刻通知你。'}

{'translation': 'Stories discussed in this episode:', 'chinese_translation': '本集討論嘅新聞：'}

  • {'translation': "iOS 27 adds opt-in setting to share data helping improve Apple's Foundation Models", 'chinese_translation': 'iOS 27 加入選擇性加入設定，分享數據協助改善 Apple 嘅 Foundation Models'}
  • {'translation': 'iCloud+ now includes Apple TV and Apple Arcade for free in select countries', 'chinese_translation': 'iCloud+ 喺部分國家免費包含 Apple TV 同 Apple Arcade'}
  • {'translation': "macOS 27 Golden Gate officially launches, here's everything new", 'chinese_translation': 'macOS 27 Golden Gate 正式推出，以下係所有新功能'}

{'translation': 'Listening and subscribing:', 'chinese_translation': '聽歌同訂閱：'}

{'translation': 'Support Chance directly via 9to5Mac Daily Plus to unlock:', 'chinese_translation': '透過 9to5Mac Daily Plus 直接支持 Chance，即可解鎖：'}

  • {'translation': 'Ad-free versions of every episode', 'chinese_translation': '所有集數嘅無廣告版本'}
  • {'translation': 'Exclusive bonus content', 'chinese_translation': '獨家加值內容'}

{'translation': 'Catch up on past 9to5Mac Daily episodes!', 'chinese_translation': '追返過去嘅 9to5Mac Daily 集數！'}

{'translation': 'Email us at happyhour@9to5mac.com to get in touch. You can also leave a review on Apple Podcasts or recommend us on Overcast to help others discover the show.', 'chinese_translation': '歡迎電郵到 happyhour@9to5mac.com 聯絡我哋。你亦可以喺 Apple Podcasts 評分，或者喺 Overcast 推薦我哋，幫更多人發現呢個節目。'}
